decisions.reason: As a low-cost training service that complements existing products and had its own webpage for two years, it remains a valuable option with little reason to drop.
This accessory is close to the firm's core milling offer and likely inexpensive to keep, making it a real option worth retaining.
Being distant from the established offer and only briefly mentioned in 2019, its results have likely not justified further commitment, so it should be abandoned.
A high-speed CNC milling machine line is close to the core business and a significant option with continued potential, so it is very likely kept.
An automatic tool change system builds directly on existing machinery and supports the core offer, so it is a low-cost option to retain.
